design.ordering: alternated within each repetition; starting arm balanced across cases
design.cache_limit: Repeated identical synthetic prompts may reuse provider cache. These measurements do not estimate production cross-turn cache improvement.

cache_probe.interpretation: The exact input prefix is longer for A2, but both arms report identical cached and cache-write tokens on changed turns 2 and 3. The first turn is order-confounded because baseline ran cold and A2 ran second. No explicit breakpoint or cache key was used.

cache_limit: Repeated identical Golden prompts warm full-request caches; their totals do not measure cross-turn reuse. The separate changing-turn probe does, but it is small and implicit cache breakpoints may prevent reuse of A2 sections within one changing input message.
